source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (public catalogue; no credential, no inference, no cost)
note: PROVIDER METADATA AT ONE POINT IN TIME. Prices are USD per token as published by the provider and may change; they are inputs to a worst-case ceiling check and are NOT billed amounts. Reasoning tokens are billed as completion tokens, so the output side is an upper-bound input to the estimate. The long-prompt override applies above 272,000 prompt tokens and no P10E request approaches that. Added 2026-10-19: the models the designated environment actually resolves for Fast, Balanced and Advanced (the owner's OPENROUTER_MODEL_* settings).
